CommunityApplications.Profile:
curtain is a public-facing, read-only dashboard for your Unraid server. It shows visitors a curated, admin-approved view - live CPU load, memory, uptime and disk metrics, a storage-usage pie, quick links to your public services, and optionally posters for the most recently added movies - with no login. It is read-only by design, only reads the specific environment variables you set, and only sees the host paths you bind-mount read-only.
This repository maintains a single container: curtain. For help, bug reports, or feature requests, open an issue at https://github.com/ggardenhire/curtain/issues.
